concept_gloss.applicability: Nesnenin kumaş oluşunu, boya veya deseni ve gerçek dokuma bezemesi gibi görünmesini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Boyalı veya desenli kumaşı ve dokunmuş bezeme izlenimini eksiksiz korur.

concept_gloss.text: dokuma bezemesi sanısı veren boyalı kumaş

concept_map.definition: Çeşitli renklerle boyanmış veya desenlenmiş, bu yüzden dokuma yoluyla bezenmiş gibi görünen bir kumaş ya da giysidir.

facets.statement: Nesne, çeşitli boya renkleriyle renklendirilmiş veya yüzeyine desen işlenmiş bir kumaştır.
Boya ve desen, kumaşın dokuma yoluyla bezenmiş olduğu izlenimini verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kumaş türünün üretim görünüşüyle birlikte açıkça anlatılması gereken bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Boyama veya yüzey deseniyle oluşturulan dokuma bezemesi izlenimini korur.

contextual_glosses.text: dokuma desenli gibi görünen boyalı kumaş

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, boyası veya deseni gerçek dokuma bezemesi sanısı veren kumaşla sınırlıdır; genel yalan, her desenli kumaş veya kişi adı değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çeşitli renklerle boyanmış veya desenlenmiş bir kumaşı, dokuma yoluyla bezenmiş gibi görünmesi üzerinden tanımlar; bir açıklama bu yanıltıcı görünüşü adlandırmanın gerekçesi yapar. Geçici çerçeve nesneyi ve görünüş ilişkisini doğru korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: dokuma bezemesi sanısı veren boyalı veya desenli kumaş

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın bir kumaş adını ve onu ayıran görünüş özelliğini verir; genel aldatıcı görünüş anlamına genişletilmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; dokuma bezemesi, renk etkisi, boyama, resimli kumaş ve yüzeyle yanıltma sınırlarını gösteren beş aday seçildi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal boya veya desenin dokuma bezemesi sanısı vermesine dayanır; komşu dal gerçek dokuma bezemesi ve onun üretimiyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Boya veya yüzey deseniyle gerçek dokuma bezemesi varmış izlenimi veren kumaşı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: bezemeye benzeyen boya ile gerçek dokuma bezemesi
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kumaştaki gerçek dokuma bezemesini, kenar süslemesini ve bu işi yapanları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kumaş yüzeyindeki bezeme görünüşü iki dalın ortak alanıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal dokuma bezemesi sanısına dayanır; komşu dal kumaş renginin bakışa göre değişmesine dayanır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birden çok boya veya desenle dokunmuş gibi görünen kumaşı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: boyalı desen yanılsaması ile değişken renk görünüşü
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bakış açısına göre renkleri değişiyormuş gibi görünen belirli bir kumaş türünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Renkli bir kumaşın görünüşünün algıda özel bir etki oluşturması iki dalda ortaktır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bezeme sanısı veren tasarlanmış görünüşü adlandırır; komşu dal belirli renkleri ve boyanın düzensiz tutmasını konu alır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çok renkli boya veya desenin dokuma bezemesi izlenimi vermesini temel alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sarı boya, belirli bitkisel renkler ve boyanın alacalı ya da iyi tutmamış çıkmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da boyanmış kumaşın renk ve yüzey görünüşü alanındadır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal üretim biçimini olduğundan farklı gösteren genel bezeme izlenimine dayanır; komşu dal belirli resim motifleriyle tanımlanır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Boyanmış veya desenlenmiş yüzeyin dokuma bezemesi sanısı vermesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: bezeme sanısı veren kumaş ile resimli kumaş
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Üzerinde kule biçimleri veya başka resimler bulunan belirli bir süslü kumaşı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yüzeyi resim veya desenle süslenmiş kumaşları konu alır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnız kumaş ve dokuma bezemesi görünüşüne bağlıdır; komşu dal metal kaplama işleminden genel yanıltıcı gösterime uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kumaşta boya veya desenin dokuma bezemesi sanısı uyandırmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kumaş görünüşü ile kaplama yoluyla yanıltma
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir metali altın veya gümüşle kaplamayı ve bir şeyi gerçek niteliğinden farklı göstermeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir nesnenin yüzey işlemiyle üretim veya madde niteliğinden farklı görünmesi iki alanda ortaktır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الكذابة ثوب يصبغ بألوان الصبغ كأنه موشي (ayn); الكذابة ثوب ينقش بلون صبغ كأنه موشى وذلك لأنه يكذب بحاله (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, çeşitli renklerle boyanıp desenlenen ve böylece dokuma bezemesi varmış gibi görünen bir kumaş üzerinde birleşir; toplu kanıt bu yanıltıcı görünüşü adlandırmanın gerekçesi olarak açıklar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكذابة للثوب المصبوغ بألوان أو المنقوش كأنه موشى لأنه يكذب بحاله
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الكذب في القول، ولا التكذيب، ولا أسماء الأشخاص

root_profile.summary: Kökün anlam ağı, söz ve davranışta doğruluğa aykırılık ile başkasını yalan sayma çekirdeğinden; yükümlülük, savaş hamlesi, gecikmeme, süt kesilmesi, hayvan hareketi, iç benlik ve kumaş görünüşü gibi sözlüksel olarak özelleşmiş alanlara uzanır. Bu alanların bir bölümü yalan veya beklentinin boşa çıkması düşüncesiyle ilişkilendirilebilirken bir bölümü bağımsızlaşmış adlandırmalar olarak kalır.

text.arabic_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دَارِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ

baseline.text: Onu yalanladılar. Bunun üzerine sarsıntı onları yakaladı da yurtlarında yere çökmüş halde sabahladılar.

findings.text: Yeryüzüne yayılan bozgunculuk, şiddetli hareketle yakalanıp kendi yurdunda yere yapışmış hareketsizliğe çevrilir.
Sabahın açılması, yalnız bir zaman bildirimi değil, yurtlarına bağlı kalan bedenlerin artık toplumsal hayatı sürdüremediği son durumu görünür kılan bir açılıştır.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood supplies the initiating speech act, not merely private disbelief.
Capture and arrest make the rajfa the grammatical captor.
Severe perturbation supplies the violent kinetic middle of the sequence.
The encircling image lets the dwelling function as the bounded field of seizure.
Adhesion to the ground supplies the terminal bodily state.

changed_reading.after: Their accusatory speech is answered by a capture: disorder itself takes them and converts active inhabitants into bodies fixed to the ground.
changed_reading.before: They denied the messenger and were killed by an earthquake.

baseline_models.mechanism: The sequenced fa-clauses turn falsehood-attribution into an agentive capture: severe disturbance takes the group and resolves motion into adhesion to the ground inside its own enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Becoming converts the event into an attained and continuing condition.
The animal that remains kneeling until morning contributes a precise non-rising image to the temporal result.
The resident attached to the house intensifies the terminal failure to depart.
Grounded staying blocks the ordinary resumption of morning activity.

changed_reading.after: Morning arrives but produces no rising: temporal renewal exposes a community whose relation to its home has become permanent non-departure.
changed_reading.before: By morning they lay motionless in their home.

baseline_models.mechanism: Morning normally reopens movement, but the resultative becoming and the non-rising branch of ص ب ح make time advance while the inhabitants do not; the dwelling holds a terminal state rather than a new day.

activation_trace.role: An encircling adverse turn lets dār double as the circumference of calamity.
Taking possession supplies the inward-closing force.
The bodily person-image makes defeat visible as a collection of abandoned bodies.
Fixity in place completes the conversion of shelter into confinement.

changed_reading.after: Their own dwelling becomes the closed geometry of their reversal: it still contains them, but only as immobilized bodies.
changed_reading.before: The verse reports where the victims fell.

baseline_models.mechanism: The dwelling root carries both enclosure and the circle of adverse reversal, so the home is not a neutral backdrop: the place of social continuity closes around its inhabitants as the boundary of defeat.

activation_trace.role: The focus begins with the people's act of assigning falsehood to another.
Assaying metal or persons supplies a test that reveals constitution under pressure.
Solidity and straightness give truth a material contrast to destabilization.
The focus supplies the actual stress of violent perturbation.
The tested conflict ends in an externally visible fixed result.

changed_reading.after: The shock functions as a material truth-test: the people pronounce falsehood, but pressure exposes and fixes the opposite verdict.
changed_reading.before: Their denial is followed by an unrelated punitive shock.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening assay imagery recasts the focus shaking as a stress test that reverses the people's verdict: they call the messenger false, while perturbation exposes which claim has solidity and fixes the outcome bodily.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, truth-as-solidity, falsehood-attribution, shaking, and fixity; I infer that the physical stress reverses the people's verbal verdict. A live alternative is that trial language only frames moral classification without making the rajfa itself an assay.
structural_cues: 29:2-3 open the surah by denying that claims will be left untested and by pairing the truthful with the liars.
29:37 places denial, violent stress, and a fixed bodily outcome in one rapid sequence.

activation_trace.role: Escaping a pursuer supplies the explicit possibility that wrongdoers imagine.
Failure to make the pursuer miss or to slip the pursuit removes spatial escape.
The repeated denial of escape places the focus event inside a surah-wide pursuit pattern.
Capture gives the pattern its concrete completion in the focus.
Ground-bound immobility marks the exact end of flight.

changed_reading.after: The rajfa catches people who cannot outstrip judgment; their own dwelling becomes the place of arrest.
changed_reading.before: A quake happens to overtake them at home.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated language of failing to outstrip or escape turns أَخَذَتْهُم into the end of a pursuit relation; جاثمين is the arrest point where attempted precedence and evasion cease.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent escape language plus capture and immobilization; I supply the pursuit arrow from imagined evasion to arrest. The alternative is a general claim of divine power with no scene-level chase image.
structural_cues: 29:4 asks whether perpetrators can outstrip the divine claimant.
29:22 denies any capacity to frustrate pursuit, and 29:39 repeats that earlier powers were not outstrippers.

activation_trace.role: The earlier disaster performs capture with the same taking root and object pattern.
The encompassing flood supplies one material mode of disaster-capture.
The repeated capture branch transfers agency to the focus catastrophe.
Severe shaking supplies the focus's distinct material mode of capture.

changed_reading.after: The rajfa is one member of a repeated family of catastrophes that actively take possession of communities.
changed_reading.before: The earthquake is one isolated means of destruction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier formula in which the flood takes Noah's people establishes catastrophe as an enclosing captor; the focus repeats the same taking construction with a different physical agent, the rajfa.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the near-identical syntax, flood-enclosure, and shaking; I infer a repeated disaster-as-captor mechanism. The alternative is that أخذ is only a conventional punishment verb and the parallel carries no spatial agency.
structural_cues: 29:14 has فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلطُّوفَانُ; 29:37 has فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ.
Both clauses place a named catastrophe after the same taking verb and pronominal object.

activation_trace.role: A manifest mark establishes ruin as something left for recognition.
Appearance and disclosure make the preceding sign publicly legible.
The house and its residents provide the focus's evidentiary site.
Bodily persons supply the stark content preserved at that site.
What becomes clear from later ruins activates the focus dwelling as disclosure.
Inhabited settlement links historical recognition specifically to surviving dwellings.

changed_reading.after: The occupied house has become a surviving exhibit: fixed bodies make denial's consequence readable in place.
changed_reading.before: The dwelling merely identifies where they died.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit leaving of a visible sign before the focus and the disclosure through dwellings immediately after it turn the house-bound bodies into readable residue; location becomes evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sign, disclosure, dwellings, and focus bodies in a dwelling; I infer that the focus tableau itself is forensic evidence. A live alternative is that 29:38 points only to other peoples and does not retrospectively characterize 29:37.
structural_cues: 29:35 ends the Lot sequence with a clear sign left behind.
29:36-37 narrate Shuayb and the fixed bodies, then 29:38 says prior peoples are evident from their dwellings.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the community's own initiating act of falsehood-attribution.
Severe perturbation is the focus's particular punitive medium.
Accountability for an issued offense explains taking as consequential seizure.
Fault supplies the stated basis that differentiates each taking.
A terrifying cry supplies a neighboring, distinct capture medium in the catalogue.
Putting something in the wrong place frames self-wronging as the source of distortion rather than arbitrary divine action.

changed_reading.after: It is the focus community's specifically indexed mode of seizure, attached to its own denial within a differentiated moral catalogue.
changed_reading.before: The rajfa is a generic catastrophe imposed from outside.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later punishment catalogue states that each was taken by its own fault, varies the taking medium, and denies divine misplacement; this calibrates the focus rajfa as a particular consequence rather than undifferentiated natural violence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fault-indexed taking, several media, and self-wronging; I infer that the focus sequence is a calibrated return of the community's own act. The alternative is juridical classification without a claim that the consequence mirrors the denial.
structural_cues: 29:40 opens with each being taken by fault and then lists wind, cry, earth-collapse, and drowning.
The verse closes by denying divine wrong and assigning the wrong to the peoples themselves.

activation_trace.role: The focus dwelling supplies enclosure without proving safety.
Capture penetrates that enclosure and takes its inhabitants.
The seized inhabitants remain attached to the supposed refuge.
House as shelter supplies the explicit protective function under examination.
Weakness of force exposes a shelter whose enclosing form cannot support its users.
The protected precinct supplies the contrasting case of an enclosure made inviolable.
Swift snatching around that precinct sharpens the difference between real security and mere location.

changed_reading.after: Their house encloses but cannot defend them; it becomes a trap that demonstrates the difference between possession of shelter and actual security.
changed_reading.before: They happen to be inside their own house when struck.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah contrasts an acquired but weakest house with a genuinely protected precinct amid surrounding snatching; the focus dār therefore tests the difference between mere enclosure and effective protection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies weak shelter, protected precinct, snatching, and focus capture inside a dwelling; I infer that the focus home fails a protection test. The alternative is that the spider comparison concerns allies alone and should not color the literal dār in 29:37.
structural_cues: 29:41 makes the house the surah's central image for structurally weak reliance.
29:67 places an actually secure precinct inside a landscape of people being snatched away.

activation_trace.role: The adverse circle turns the present dwelling into a failed form of residence.
Adhesion and immobility define that failed residence bodily.
Being installed in an abode supplies the positive act of secure accommodation.
Upper rooms invert the focus's ground-bound posture.
Flow beneath the rooms contrasts living motion with focus fixity.
A turn of conditions distinguishes the ultimate dwelling from the present one.
The living-creature image supplies the explicit life pole missing from the focus house.
The focus act recurs in the closing denial of truth and ties speech to destination.
Terminal lodging supplies the other endpoint of residence for deniers.

changed_reading.after: It stages a negative habitation: denial leaves bodies fixed low in a lifeless home, against elevated flowing accommodation and before denial's terminal lodging.
changed_reading.before: The verse ends with death in a current dwelling.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later habitation images place the focus dwelling between elevated, flowing accommodation and the terminal lodging of deniers; the inert house scene becomes a negative lodging in which fixed residence lacks both movement and life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed habitations, vertical position, flow, life, repeated denial, and lodging; I infer that 29:37 is a proleptic anti-home between them. The alternative is a broad thematic contrast with no claim that the focus scene anticipates either final residence.
structural_cues: 29:58 lodges believers in upper rooms with rivers moving below them.
29:64 calls the later dār true life, while 29:68 joins denial of truth to a final lodging question.

activation_trace.role: Being turned away supplies the loss of directed motion before the focus aftermath is generalized.
An extended traversable road supplies the route from which movement was diverted.
Grounded immobility gives diversion a terminal bodily form.
Strenuous exertion supplies the opposite commitment to movement.
Gentle direction toward a road supplies restored orientation.
Plural paths keep the successful side of the contrast open and mobile.

changed_reading.after: Their fixed posture also completes a trajectory of misdirection: those turned from the road stop inside the house, while strivers are given paths.
changed_reading.before: Jāthimīn only describes the physical aftermath of the rajfa.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah renders moral orientation kinetically: diversion from the road culminates in being fixed inside a dwelling, while strenuous movement receives further paths; juthum is the bodily endpoint of blocked direction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies diversion, roads, exertion, guidance, and focus immobility; I infer a kinetic moral contrast in which wrong orientation ends as arrested posture. The alternative is that bodily juthum and ethical path language remain independent image systems.
structural_cues: 29:38 follows the focus by saying people were diverted from the path despite possessing sight.
29:69 closes the surah with striving answered by guidance into paths.

remaining_uncertainties: The report-agitation branch of ر ج ف is a rhetorical resonance, not a claim that al-rajfa means rumor here.
The assay and proleptic-lodging models depend on cross-ayah structural inference rather than explicit local syntax.
The non-rising animal image in ص ب ح should not override the ordinary resultative force of أصبحوا.
strongest_changes: Recurring no-outstripping language turns the rajfa into arrest after failed escape.
The sign-and-dwelling sequence makes the bodies in the house readable residue rather than incidental location.
House, sanctuary, and lodging contrasts recast dār as tested protection and as a negative habitation.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly translates speech and moral orientation into kinetics and architecture: false attribution, testing, pursuit, seizure, immobilization, shelter, and terminal residence.

activation_trace.role: Assigning falsehood supplies an attempt to destabilize the messenger's truth by speech.
Agitating people through bad or false reports supplies a discursive form of destabilization.
Severe physical disturbance keeps the focus event materially grounded.
Final stillness reverses both social and physical agitation.

changed_reading.after: Their falsehood-attribution tries to shake truth socially; that destabilization returns as a real shock that silences and fixes its agents.
changed_reading.before: Verbal denial is followed by physical shaking.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the report-agitation branch belongs most directly to irjāf rather than the noun al-rajfa here. It remains anchored because the same root stands between explicit falsehood-attribution and enforced bodily stillness, while the severe-shaking branch preserves the local sense. Render it as rhetorical and causal resonance, not as a replacement gloss for al-rajfa.

activation_trace.role: A condition that takes hold of the body supplies involuntary bodily seizure.
Morning supplies the threshold at which a night-bound image would normally release.
The resident held at home provides the intimate interior setting.
The jāthūm or nightmare branch contributes pressure that pins a sleeper and blocks rising.
The bodily-person branch prevents the image from dissolving into a purely mental dream.

changed_reading.after: The aftermath resembles a communal nightmare made irreversible: seizure pins whole bodies under their own roof, and dawn brings no release.
changed_reading.before: At morning the victims are found motionless at home.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because jāthūm normally supplies a sleep-paralysis or nightmare image, whereas the syntax reports a public catastrophe and its aftermath. It remains anchored through morning, bodily taking, the house, and the shared ج ث م root. Render it only as an embodied analogy for oppressive seizure, never as a claim that the people were asleep or dreaming.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Movement terminated in low immobility.** ج ث م B001 is clinging low and staying in place; B003 is the visible bodily person. The quake supplies violent motion, yet morning finds bodies fixed in their abode. I infer that the external shaking removes their capacity for self-directed movement; جاثمين reads as a spatial reversal in which those who spread corruption are reduced to motionless presence at home.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:40 places the quake beside storm, cry, sinking, and drowning. That catalog clarifies the motion-to-immobility mechanism as one tailored material reversal among several.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Spreading corruption is reversed into violent motion and then immobilization.** Lexical evidence: `أَخَذَتْهُم`, root `ء خ ذ`, `B002` (taking to account for a fault); `ٱلرَّجْفَة`, root `ر ج ف`, `B001` (violent shaking); `فَأَصْبَحُوا`, root `ص ب ح`, `B010` (becoming with *aṣbaḥa*); and `جَاثِمِين`, root `ج ث م`, `B001` (clinging low and staying in place). Structural cue: `29:36` describes corruption spreading through earth; this ayah moves from seizure through maximum agitation to a dawn-state of low stillness in their own residences. Assigned role: shaking undoes stability, while crouched clinging ends movement. Abductive move: I infer a reversal mechanism from spread to forced immobility; the packet supplies the opposed motion images but not that explicit arrow. Reading change: the consequence fits the prior mode spatially: uncontrolled diffusion ends in fixed collapse.

2. **The ordinary morning opening becomes a disclosure of a terminal state.** Lexical evidence: `أَصْبَحُوا`, root `ص ب ح`, `B001` (dawn and morning opening) alongside grammatical `B010`; `دَارِهِم`, root `د و ر`, `B004` (an adverse turn or misfortune) and `B007` (one attached to a residence). Structural cue: after the night-to-morning transition, the inhabitants remain attached to the place but no longer animate its social life; `29:38` turns such dwellings into visible evidence. Assigned role: morning reveals; residence localizes; adverse turn characterizes the disclosed condition. Abductive move: the opening of morning is not stated as causal, so I infer only an unveiling function. Reading change: `فأصبحوا` marks a revealed transformation, not merely clock time.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later contrast (`29:58`):** The collapsed bodies fixed in their dwellings are answered by faithful workers deliberately settled in upper chambers amid continuing flow. Both are stable placements, but one is immobilized aftermath and the other enduring, provisioned habitation; “staying” acquires opposite moral architectures.

words.gloss_range: consequence connector opening the ayah as response to the prior exhortation and beginning the three-link sequence
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) opens the ayah as consequence, not as a neutral restart. It makes the denial answer Shuayb's prior exhortation in 29:36 and also begins the three-part fa-chain whose beats move from denial to seizure to final stillness.

topics.headline: opening consequence from prior speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins as the immediate answer to 29:36, so the denial is already framed as consequence.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as sequential, and the boundary rows tie its scope to the prior Shuayb speech in 29:36.

topics.headline: first beat of the triple fa cascade
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first clipped beat of a three-step cascade rather than a loose narrative connector.
topics.reason: The ayah contains three fa-linked perfect clauses, and this first particle launches that internal rhythm.

words.gloss_range: Form II completed denial directed by a plural group against the singular messenger object
words.prose: {{ar:كَذَّبُوهُ}} ({{tr:kadhdhabūhu}}) compresses the confrontation into one word: a plural subject declares one messenger false. The Form II shape, including its doubled middle articulation, selects active falsification-claim, not mere lying and not proof that he is false, so the falsehood root rebounds ironically onto the accusers. As the first verbal event, it is the punishment-pivot formula that leads at once into seizure, with wider destruction parallels such as 26:189 and the same-surah judgment summary in 29:40.
words.root_gloss_range: lying, falsehood, and declaring another false; here Form II with a personal object selects accusatory denial rather than simple lying or proven falsification

topics.headline: plural deniers target one messenger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the whole confrontation packed into one form: the community acts together while the prior messenger remains the singular object.
topics.reason: The 3mp subject agreement and 3ms object suffix are morphologically present, and attachment evidence resolves the suffix back to Shuayb from 29:36.

topics.headline: Form II declares false without proving false
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are not simply lying; they are aggressively classifying the messenger as false, while the form stops short of proving him false.
topics.reason: The root field supports falsehood and accusation, but the local PV:II form with a personal object narrows the active sense to declaring another false.

topics.headline: denial becomes the hinge into seizure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the denial as the narrative hinge where human agency triggers the reversal into being seized.
topics.reason: Distributional and inter-ayah rows place the word in a repeated denial-to-punishment pattern, locally tightened by adjacency to the seizure clause.

words.gloss_range: second fa linking denial to seizure as immediate consequence and agency reversal
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the seizure follow as therefore, not merely as a later event. This middle connector is the hinge where the acting deniers become the acted-upon object, and its repeated short beat keeps the ayah's domino rhythm audible.

topics.headline: second fa makes seizure consequential
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quake-seizure is grammatically attached to denial as its immediate consequence.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the second clause as result, and the particle is fused to the seizure verb.

topics.headline: hinge from human action to overpowering agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the pivot from people acting to people being acted upon at the connector itself.
topics.reason: The surrounding clauses shift from the people's denial to the quake as subject seizing them.

words.gloss_range: active Form I seizure with the quake as feminine subject and the people as plural object
words.prose: {{ar:أَخَذَتْهُمُ}} ({{tr:akhadhat-humu}}) makes the quake the acting subject and the people the seized object before the subject is even named. The broad taking root is narrowed by this punishment frame into grasping seizure: the rajfa does not merely occur near them, it takes hold of them. The same seizure formula is shared with punishment scenes such as 7:78 and 7:91, and 29:40 later restates the judgment with God seizing each by sin.
words.root_gloss_range: taking, grasping, receiving, and punitive seizure; here the quake subject and punishment context select overpowering seizure with accountability pressure

topics.headline: feminine verb makes the quake agent

topics.reason: The verb is 3fs because its overt subject is the feminine event noun at word 5, and the active form keeps the seizing force foregrounded.

topics.reason: The root's broad taking field survives as grasp imagery, but the Form I surface and quake subject select direct external seizure.

words.gloss_range: definite single quake event functioning as the subject of seizure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرَّجْفَةُ}} ({{tr:al-rajfatu}}) names the agent that seized them: one definite quake-event, not a vague calamity. Its violent trembling supplies the middle force between denial and bodies pressed motionless, and the article's sun-letter assimilation gives the onset a tightened rattling feel. The broader agitation and eschatological quake field remains a qualified echo through 29:34 and 79:6 rather than the local sense itself.
words.root_gloss_range: trembling, shaking, agitation, and eschatological quaking; here the local form selects one physical punishment-quake while wider agitation and final-quake echoes remain secondary

words.gloss_range: third fa introducing the resultant state after the seizure and completing the cascade
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns the seizure into its visible result. The third short connector supplies the closing audible beat of the ayah's cascade and shifts the grammar from an event that happens to them into the state in which they are found.

topics.headline: third fa introduces the aftermath state

words.gloss_range: Form IV completed becoming/morning verb taking a locative phrase and prone predicate
words.prose: {{ar:أَصْبَحُوا۟}} ({{tr:aṣbaḥū}}) opens the final state clause as a completed becoming: they ended up in their dwelling as prone bodies. The Form IV verb is copulative here, taking the locative phrase and final predicate, but its morning root keeps an exposure value alive, as if dawn discloses the collapsed scene. That aftermath formula is answered in 29:38, where the ruins become visible to others.
words.root_gloss_range: morning, becoming, brightness, and disclosure; here Form IV functions copulatively while its morning register makes the aftermath feel exposed

topics.headline: completed becoming governs place and predicate

words.gloss_range: locative preposition placing the final predicate inside the community's dwelling
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes containment the frame of the final state. The bodies are not merely near a dwelling or associated with it; the predicate is set inside their own habitation, and the separate short preposition gives that locative frame weight before the closing posture arrives.

topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a spatial preposition governing the dwelling, and attachment evidence ties it to the final state clause.

words.gloss_range: their definite dwelling or communal habitation as governed locative complement
words.prose: {{ar:دَارِهِمْ}} ({{tr:dārihim}}) is not scenery in the background. The construct with the plural suffix makes the dwelling specifically theirs, while the singular noun treats the community as one inhabited domain. The broader abode and return register is narrowed to a concrete habitation here, but it makes the place of return feel terminal, especially beside the motionless predicate. The phrase also belongs to a punishment-location formula seen in 7:78, 7:91, and 11:67, and it anticipates the abode contrast of 29:64 and the visible habitations in 29:38.
words.root_gloss_range: dwelling, abode, domain, turning, and return; here the locative selects the concrete habitation while return/abode pressure colors the aftermath

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative active participle predicate describing the people as crouched, prone, and motionless
words.prose: {{ar:جَٰثِمِينَ}} ({{tr:jāthimīna}}) is the final predicate, not an incidental adjective or fixed title. Its indefinite accusative masculine plural form ties the prone condition to the whole human group governed by the copulative verb at word 7, and the active participle presents a continuing state rather than a momentary fall. The root's crouched, pressed-low bodily image makes the ayah end in visible immobility, while its rare Quranic profile marks a fixed destruction-aftereffect. Its consonant path closes toward final m, so even the sound observation suits the semantic settling into stillness; the participial contrast with 29:38 then moves from fallen bodies here to perceiving observers there.
words.root_gloss_range: crouching low, staying fixed, bodily mass, and pressed immobility; here the participle selects a sustained visible aftermath posture
